name: copy
description: 复制文件/目录（替代 terminal 的 cp/Copy-Item）。支持批量（sources 数组）。目录递归复制（100MB 上限）。覆盖策略：error（默认，目标存在即失败）/ rename（自动重命名避开冲突）/ overwrite（覆盖目标，改前自动备份支持 undo）。复制产生的副本登记为 create 条目（undo = 删除副本）。
description_en: Copy files/directories (use instead of terminal cp/Copy-Item). Supports batching (sources array). Directories are copied recursively (100MB limit). Overwrite strategies: error (default, fail if destination exists) / rename (auto-rename to avoid conflicts) / overwrite (replace destination with automatic pre-change backup, undo supported). Copies are registered as create entries (undo = delete the copy).

source.description: 源文件/目录的绝对或相对路径（单源模式，与 sources 互斥）
source.description_en: Absolute or relative path of the source file/directory (single-source mode, mutually exclusive with sources)

sources.description: 批量源路径数组（多源模式，与 source 互斥；此时 dest 必须是已存在的目录）
sources.description_en: Array of source paths for batch mode (multi-source mode, mutually exclusive with source; dest must be an existing directory)

dest.description: 目标路径。单源时可为新路径或已存在目录（复制入内）；多源时必须是已存在目录
dest.description_en: Destination path. In single-source mode it can be a new path or an existing directory (copy into it); in multi-source mode it must be an existing directory

overwrite.description: 目标已存在时的策略：error=报错（默认）；rename=自动改名；overwrite=覆盖（覆盖前备份，支持 undo）
overwrite.description_en: Strategy when destination already exists: error=fail (default); rename=auto-rename; overwrite=replace (backs up before overwriting, undo supported)

dryRun.description: 预演模式：返回将执行的复制清单，不执行任何操作
dryRun.description_en: Dry-run mode: returns the list of copies that would be performed without executing anything
